London. The capital and largest city of the United Kingdom, situated on the River Thames in southeastern England. Founded by the Romans as Londinium, it grew into a medieval trading center and became the political and commercial heart of the British Empire.

The Romans founded London around forty-seven CE as Londinium. After Roman withdrawal, it developed into a major Anglo-Saxon and then medieval trading city on the Thames. The Tower of London was built by William the Conqueror in ten sixty-six and served as royal palace, fortress, and prison. It houses the Crown Jewels and remains a symbol of royal authority.

Big Ben, officially the Great Bell and now Elizabeth Tower, is the iconic clock tower at the Palace of Westminster. It was completed in eighteen fifty-nine and is recognized worldwide as a symbol of London and Britain. Charles Dickens, born in eighteen twelve and dying in eighteen seventy, was the preeminent Victorian novelist. He set much of his work in London and used the city to expose social inequality, poverty, and human resilience.

Arthur Conan Doyle's fictional detective Sherlock Holmes, set in Victorian London, became one of literature's most iconic characters and defined the detective genre. London became the center of the British Empire and grew explosively during the Industrial Revolution. By the nineteenth century it was the world's largest city and financial capital.

London survived the Blitz, Nazi aerial bombardment during World War II from nineteen forty to nineteen forty-one, which destroyed large sections of the city. This devastation demonstrated British resilience. The city rebuilt and remains a major cultural and financial center. Its neoclassical architecture, designed by Italian and Russian architects like Bartolomeo Rastrelli, exemplifies eighteenth-century imperial grandeur and remains largely preserved.

The Palace of Westminster, which houses Parliament, overlooks the Thames and represents the legislative body that shaped British government and inspired democracies worldwide. London's integration of its medieval fortress, modern financial center, and cultural institutions makes it one of the world's most influential cities culturally, financially, and politically.
